_comment: Inventory of the drag-and-drop editor's module kinds, the product term each one is called by, and what an HTML round trip costs it. Generated from the platform's own constants; the kinds are the module list of the editor SDK the app loads.
A stored module type is the prefix plus the kind, e.g. prefix + 'social'.
Terms are what a person reads. The kind and the prefix are internal identifiers and must not appear in customer-facing text.

divider.roundTrip: comes back as a styled line; the divider block is gone

menu.roundTrip: comes back as links; the editable menu is gone

social.roundTrip: comes back as images with links; the editable block is gone

icons.roundTrip: comes back as images with links; the editable block is gone

html.roundTrip: comes back as the markup it renders to; the code block is gone

video.roundTrip: comes back as a preview image with a link; the video block is gone

table.roundTrip: comes back as plain markup; the editable table is gone

form.roundTrip: comes back as markup; the form no longer works

carousel.roundTrip: comes back as the visible slide; the rest of the carousel is lost

merge-content.roundTrip: comes back as its resolved content; the merge block is gone

addon.roundTrip: comes back as its rendered output; the add-on is gone

pageLevelCosts.webFonts: The web fonts of this newsletter are not carried through a replacement.
pageLevelCosts.backgroundImage: A row background image is not carried through a replacement.
pageLevelCosts.headStyles: The own head styles of this newsletter are not carried through a replacement.

unknownKindRule: A type outside 'kinds' is a provider addition nobody reviewed. Report it as unknown; keep it apart from a kind that is known and costly.
addOnTrap: Every add-on is stored as the 'addon' kind. Name the concrete add-on from the content-dialog handle inside the module, never from the type.
